title: codex fetch_codex_usage
description: One developer's Codex usage for one UTC day: the raw row from the Codex Enterprise Analytics usage endpoint, stored verbatim. OpenAI publishes no schema; the connector reads only user_id, bucket_start_time and actor.email.

user_id.description: The developer's OpenAI account id. Never empty and never contains "|"; the run fails otherwise.

bucket_start_time.description: Start of the day the vendor filed the row under, in Unix seconds. When present and non-zero it falls on the requested UTC day; the run fails otherwise.

email.description: The developer's email, or null. Copied to metadata developer_email.
